analysis.title: PJT Partners (PJT): First Take: Largely in-line EPS through non-comp discipline, despite slight top-line miss
key_insights: PJT reported adjusted 3Q26 EPS of $1.41 vs GSe $1.32 and Visible Alpha consensus $1.33. Normalizing the tax rate, GS puts core EPS at $1.35.
GS expects an in-line to slightly negative market response: the revenue miss vs the Street is offset by a non-comp beat and an in-line comp ratio.
Revenue of $385mn was 1% below consensus and down 14% YoY, due to lower strategic advisory, restructuring and private capital solutions revenue, partly offset by higher primary fundraising revenue.
The multiplier of reported revenue to Dealogic revenue was 5.9x (adjusted for GS's estimated net pull-forward), vs a 5.2x 3Q average over the past 4 years.
Adjusted pre-tax margin was 18.8%, about 50bps above consensus, driven entirely by a non-comp ratio about 55bps lower than consensus.
The 3Q26 comp ratio was 66.5%, unchanged QoQ and down about 100bps YoY.
Non-comp dollars were 5% below consensus but up 10% YoY, driven by communications and information services (tech investment), occupancy, D&A from global office expansion, and travel.
PJT repurchased $31mn of shares in 3Q26 vs GSe $57mn and $29mn in 3Q25. $739mn of repurchase authorization remains, and PJT intends to repurchase 75k partnership units for cash on 11/05/26.
PJT maintained its quarterly dividend at $0.25/share of class A common stock.

GS questions for management: drivers of the revenue shortfall and the outlook for M&A revenue and secondaries, upside to restructuring revenue, sponsor M&A outlook given higher interest rates, margin and comp leverage outlook, and capital return strategy.

market_movers.rationale: GS stays Buy with a 12-month target of $180 based on 19.0x Q5-Q8 P/E, implying 17.2% upside from $153.58. The target was cut from $182 on 1 Oct 26 and set at $180 on 13 Oct 26.

earnings_insights: PJT 3Q26 adjusted EPS $1.41 reported (adjusted) vs GSe $1.32 and Visible Alpha consensus $1.33, reported 11/3/26. GS normalized-tax core EPS is $1.35.
PJT 3Q26 revenue $385mn reported, 1% below consensus and down 14% YoY.
PJT 3Q26 adjusted pre-tax margin 18.8% reported, about 50bps above consensus. Comp ratio 66.5% reported, unchanged QoQ and down about 100bps YoY.
GS forecasts for PJT: EPS $7.41 for 12/26E, $9.02 for 12/27E and $10.12 for 12/28E. Revenue is $1,862.1mn for 12/26E, $2,098.0mn for 12/27E and $2,229.1mn for 12/28E. These are GS estimates.
GS quarterly EPS forecasts: $1.32 for 9/26E (the quarter just reported), $2.59 for 12/26E and $1.82 for 3/27E. 6/26 EPS was $1.97.
risk_factors: Weaker M&A backlogs, translating into weaker revenue expectations.
Longer time to completion pushing out both M&A and restructuring revenue.
Slower scaling of the business means revenue growth disappoints.
Longer-term share losses through slower market and vertical expansion than competitors.
